preservation: All 185 inherited core modules, all inherited Python sources, appendices, bibliographies and provenance are byte-preserved. Every v80 top-level file is snapshotted under provenance/v80-*. The complete v80 article is assembled in the supplement. Previous paper directories and review branches are unchanged.
source_assembly: The byte-preserved v80 assembler is extended by one wrapper. It inserts the complete v80 abstract and body and loads its actual core files; scoped references resolve both ordinary and external-supplement labels. The supplement records all 185 inherited cores; the journal records 11 cores (174,177,180-188); their union is all 188.
field_scope: The same canonical field and exact source are retained. A joint endpoint/incidence estimate gives optical and genuine grazing initial-mass height Cr, uniformly in each previously fixed initial |g|>=a cutoff. It does not exchange cutoff and collision limits or prove the untruncated critical defect height.
recoupling_scope: The maximal coupling preserves one fixed exact label and the physical endpoint-momentum angle. It may pair different actual words. Its defect is at most the forward stopped-flow defect for the specified field, not asserted smaller than every two-sided scalar or arbitrary-field modulus.
current_scope: The same first-exit nongrazing source and common kernels remain. Joint volume localization improves the paid inverse-Jacobian drift uniformly in a positive initial cutoff; it does not provide a new surface-flux height bound.
limit_order: Fix B, epsilon(B), r(B), and all auxiliary bands before collision limsup; enlarge auxiliary band afterwards, and B last. No collision-dependent Fourier band, guard alteration, label pooling or zero-class normalization.
qualification_scope: Exact-SHA preservation, normal/optimized finite fixtures, complete native journal and 185-core supplement, actual 188-core recorder union, stable warning-free references and page geometry. Not continuum mathematical certification or independent specialist review.
new_complete_estimate: The complete optical volume source restricted to |g|<b has fixed-width normalized height C b^(129/128). First inverse-gradient truncations have a leading bound independent of the fixed lower cutoff. Thus optical loss plus genuine grazing starting mass is Cr, and the nongrazing pullback cost is Cr, rather than Cr/a. The complete critical tail and nongrazing outgoing flux heights remain unproved.
validation_scope: Finite rational/algebraic fixtures, source preservation, normal/optimized agreement, native TeX builds, recorder coverage and PDF geometry. These checks are not a continuum proof certificate or an independent specialist review.
spectral_scope: Uses the pinned full-occupation norms, power bounds, peripheral physical representatives and moving-peak Gaussian estimates. New smallness is for the specific endpoint indicator vector, not the multiplier norm. A nonzero chart reference is obtained from a unit-modulus physical eigenvector, not by dividing by Pi 1. Both chronological cases retain the original occupation coefficient and all arithmetic peaks.
unbounded_insertion_scope: Joint leading gain b^(129/128) s^(17/16), with finite-count error capped by min(b rho^(m/2),s^2). Integrating incidence gives error b^(1/2) rho^(m/4). The actual mixed I_m |g|^-eta source is integrated to zero for eta<1/2. First inverse-gradient bounds retain a positive cutoff and its finite-count a^-1/2 error.
v82_scope: Exact dyadic majorant for the existing Abel source, a sufficient pointwise cumulative-mass and uniform-tail criterion, and strict separation from nongrazing surface current. This is not a proof of the criterion or pointwise LLT.
